subject: UAV FLIGHTS, IN SUPPORT OF HELLENIC POLICE-COAST GUARD OPERATIONS
text:
A4068/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QWULW/IV/BO /W /090/110/3554N02902E061 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611100800  C) 2611201300  D) 10 16 18 20 0800-1300  E) UAV FLIGHTS, IN SUPPORT OF HELLENIC POLICE-COAST GUARD OPERATIONS
WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- AREA: 362900N 0280300E - 363300N 0282900E - 361408N 0284936E - 
361400N 0282944E - 362900N 0280300E.
AWYS R19 AND M601 (RDS-LAKAD), G18 AND L609 (RDS-NILAS), L995
(RDS-IRBAX), G80 AND N128 (RDS-BANRO), RODOS TMA AFFECTED.
VERTICAL LIMITS: FL100-FL110.
2.- AREA: 361400N 0283000E - 361400N 0285000E - 355500N 0295900E -
354300N 0295900E - 360500N 0282500E - 361400N 0283000E.
AWYS R19 AND M601 (LAKAD-EVENO), G18 AND L609 (NILAS-ALKIS), L995
(IRBAX-OBUPO), N128 (VAXOS-FOXLI) AFFECTED.
VERTICAL LIMITS: 9000FT-FL100.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR UNIT CONDUCTING THE ACTIVITIES:
3.1.- FLIGHT PLANS MUST BE SUBMITTED AND PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE
ATC UNIT MUST BE OBTAINED.
3.2.- OUT OF TMAS, THE LIAISONS OF THE UNIT CONDUCTING THE
ACTIVITIES SHALL ESTABLISH CONTACT WITH ATHINAI CONTROL.
4.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
4.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING ACTIVITIES, NON EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREAS
DESIGNATED IN PARAS (1) AND (2) ABOVE.
4.2- OTHER AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE ABOVE DESCRIBED AREAS WILL
BE END PART 1 OF 2
